modern: What power man has to do nothing except what God will approve, and to accept all that God may give him.
original: What a power man has to do nothing except what God will approve, and to accept all that God may give him.
notification: What power man has to do nothing except what God will approve, and to accept all that God may give him.
notification_original: What a power man has to do nothing except what God will approve, and to accept all that God may give him.

explained.summary: Marcus marvels at how much power a person has: the power to do only what God would approve, and to accept whatever God sends. Both are entirely within your reach. You can always choose to act well, and you can always welcome what happens rather than fighting it.
